changelog.notes: pay_x402 now accepts CAIP-2 Solana chain identifiers in `paymentRequirements.network`, matching the x402 spec that real gateways (agonx402, etc.) emit. Accepted values: 'solana' (cluster-agnostic, resolves to the server's configured cluster), 'solana-devnet', 'solana-mainnet', 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' (CAIP-2 mainnet), 'solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1' (CAIP-2 devnet). Previously only plain 'solana' / 'solana-devnet' were accepted, which broke any agent that forwarded a real x402 gateway's 402 response intact. Cluster-specific values that don't match the server's cluster now return a precise 'Network mismatch' error instead of 'Unsupported network'. This deployment is on devnet; mainnet chain ids are rejected until a mainnet deployment exists.

pay_x402 is now fully on-chain. Previous versions only recorded x402 payment intents — the actual SPL transfer never submitted, so upstream API providers never got paid. The service now builds + submits an execute_pay_exact tx mirroring make_payment (pre-creates destination + treasury ATAs, enforces the policy on-chain, collects the 1.5% service fee, reimburses relayer gas from the vault's fee_vault PDA). Response shape gained xPaymentHeader — a base64-encoded JSON proof the agent SHOULD set as the X-PAYMENT header when retrying the original paywalled URL so the upstream API releases the content. Also added pending_confirmation status for tx-timeout cases (previously only confirmed/failed/duplicate).

Fixed execute_pay_exact failing with ConstraintMut (anchor error 2000): the backend instruction builder was passing the authority and fee_vault accounts as non-writable, but the on-chain program declares both as mut (authority receives reimbursement lamports, fee_vault has lamports debited). Also corrected the anchor error label map — 2000 is constraint_mut, not invalid_program_id.

make_payment now pre-creates the destination and treasury associated token accounts (ATAs) inside the same tx when they don't exist yet. Previously paying a wallet that had never held the mint failed with anchor_error_3012 (AccountNotInitialized). Uses the idempotent ATA-create variant so it's a no-op when accounts already exist. Also: agent error responses now map a wider range of anchor framework codes (2000–4100) to human-readable reason slugs, so agents see 'account_not_initialized' or 'constraint_seeds' instead of a bare number.

idempotencyKey is now optional on make_payment, execute_swap, and pay_x402 — the server auto-generates one per request. Most agents should simply omit the field. Provide an explicit key only when you want client-side retry safety (same key + same body = same outcome). Also: the backend now recovers from 'zombie' idempotency records (approved + persisted but no tx signature after 90s) — retries are no longer silently echoed a stuck 'created' status from a prior crashed attempt.

Fee model overhaul: the vault's on-chain fee_vault PDA now reimburses the tx fee payer after each agent action, so the vault economically pays its own gas. Users no longer need to manage a separate fee-payer keypair — deposit SOL into the fee_vault (via the dashboard) once and agent payments work indefinitely. New endpoint GET /v1/config/relayer returns the service relayer pubkey so frontends can auto-configure authorized_agent at vault creation. Anchor program upgraded in place: initialize_vault now accepts an optional authorized_agent param; execute_pay_exact reimburses the tx fee payer from fee_vault (bounded by FEE_REIMBURSEMENT_LAMPORTS = 10000, with rent-exempt guard). Existing vaults must call update_authorized_agent once to point at the service relayer.
check_vault now returns real on-chain token balances (previously always empty). Balances are an array of { mint, symbol, amount, uiAmount, decimals } filtered to non-zero holdings.
Skill files now served with real HTTPS API URL (no more {LOBSTERPAY_API_URL} placeholders or localhost defaults). Added versioning so agents can detect updates.
Initial release: check_vault, make_payment, get_swap_quote, execute_swap, pay_x402 tools.
